name: How do I choose the right location on my property to place a tiny home for rent?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right location on my property to place a tiny home for rent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right location involves considering several factors: local zoning setback requirements, accessibility for utilities (water, sewer, electricity), privacy for both the main residence and the tiny home, and tenant access. Proximity to amenities like public transport or local shops can also enhance its appeal. Sunlight exposure, drainage, and maintaining clear emergency access are also important. Zen Tiny Homes can assist with site assessment and placement recommendations during the design phase to ensure optimal functionality and compliance.
